parent_objective: implement a no-PPO per-action-dimension residual gate after scalar gate behaves too much like alpha scaling

public_gates: M789 implements a vector residual calibrator
M789 freezes base actor and M761 residual head
M789 trains only vector calibrator parameters
M789 blocks PPO and checkpoint promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not mutate M761 residual head
do not weaken strict normal retention or intervention gap thresholds
do not use terminal margin or fault labels as deploy-time inputs
do not hide public active-source pressure
do not claim broad generalization or true four-wheel physical fidelity

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether per-action-dimension residual gating beats the M786 scalar-gate Pareto point without normal regression
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: implementation diagnostic only; no PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if base actor or residual head checksum changes
stop if deploy-time oracle inputs are used
stop if thresholds are weakened after M788
fallback_plan: if component gates collapse to scalar behavior, audit and stop vector-gate branch or design residual component attribution
if normal collisions return, audit before coefficient changes
if strong alpha 0.2 candidate passes, audit source-diversity and public-overfit risk before another implementation
if no Pareto lift appears, stop residual calibration or return to corpus/architecture evidence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M788 admits one vector residual calibration implementation

hypothesis: A per-action-dimension vector gate can preserve intervention residual components while suppressing risky low-margin normal components, improving the M786 scalar-gate Pareto point.
success_criteria: M789 writes run artifacts and docs
M789 confirms actor and residual head checksums unchanged
M789 trains only vector calibrator parameters
M789 reports component gate statistics and active-source margins
M789 records whether any alpha beats the M786 alpha 0.15 Pareto point
failure_criteria: implementation mutates base actor or residual head
implementation omits component gate statistics or active source metrics

commands.name: vector_calibration_probe
commands.command: implement and run per-action-dimension vector residual calibration probe; expected run dir runs/m789_v4_vector_residual_calibration

decision_rule: M789 may implement and run only a no-PPO vector residual calibration probe. It must not mutate the base actor, mutate the M761 residual head, run PPO, or promote a checkpoint.
